description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'PyTorchBackendInterface' for JIT backends in the PyTorch framework, specifying methods for backend availability, compilation, and execution.

classes.name: PyTorchBackendInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for a JIT backend in PyTorch, providing methods for checking availability, compiling modules, and executing methods.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Returns true if the backend is available to process delegation calls.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a module using specified method compile specifications, returning backend handles.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a backend method handle with given inputs, returning the outputs.
